dialogues.jp:
萌先輩に荷物の整理をしてもらいながら、手に
した松葉杖をいじる。
dialogues.en: "Are you sure you don't want me to go with you?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure you don't want me to go with you?"

dialogues.jp:
まだ完治はしてないので、１週間ほどコイツの
世話にならねばならない。
dialogues.en: "Yeah, it's fine. I'm just..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, it's fine. I'm just..."

dialogues.jp: 「……かったる」
dialogues.en:
Her face red, she took a quick glance at me, her knees
practically knocking.
dialogues.text:
Her face red, she took a quick glance at me, her knees
practically knocking.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「入学式のまえに退院できて、よかったです」
dialogues.en: "I still feel... embarassed..."
dialogues.text: "I still feel... embarassed..."

dialogues.jp:
嬉しそうに微笑む萌先輩だが、この手の行事は、
参加することにすら意味がない。
dialogues.en: "Haha..."
dialogues.text: "Haha..."

dialogues.jp: どうせなら明日、退院のほうがよかったな。
dialogues.en:
Not knowing what to say, I unconsciously scratched my cheek.
I was certain my face was as red as hers.
dialogues.text:
Not knowing what to say, I unconsciously scratched my cheek.
I was certain my face was as red as hers.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、いつまでもベッドを占拠してたら、本当
に必要な患者に悪い。
dialogues.en:
"I need to walk home and feel the cool wind... my body's
still so hot..."
dialogues.text:
"I need to walk home and feel the cool wind... my body's
still so hot..."

dialogues.jp:
（でも、萌先輩に看病してもらえなくなるのは、
　残念かな……）
dialogues.en: "Ahh, okay, then... take care."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, okay, then... take care."

dialogues.jp:
入院中は毎日世話をしてくれた萌先輩を、とて
も身近に感じることができたのに、これからは
学園でちょっと会えるぐらいになる。
dialogues.en: "I will. The next time, I'd see you in school."
dialogues.text: "I will. The next time, I'd see you in school."

dialogues.jp:
すごく親密な気がしていたので、普段の関係に
戻るのが寂しい。
dialogues.en: "Ahh... tomorrow's Sunday."
dialogues.text: "Ahh... tomorrow's Sunday."

dialogues.en:
When we started dating, I found out that she's part of a
choir. They practiced every Sunday.
dialogues.text:
When we started dating, I found out that she's part of a
choir. They practiced every Sunday.

dialogues.jp: いつの間にか、萌先輩が整理を終えていた。
dialogues.en:
So that she could concentrate on that, we decided not to
meet on Sundays.
dialogues.text:
So that she could concentrate on that, we decided not to
meet on Sundays.

dialogues.jp: 「え？　ああ、もうバッチリです」
dialogues.en: "Then I'd see you in two days time."
dialogues.text: "Then I'd see you in two days time."

dialogues.jp: つい、萌先輩を見ながらボーっとしてしまった。
dialogues.en: "Bye bye!"
dialogues.text: "Bye bye!"

dialogues.jp: 「ええと……じゃあ、いきましょう」
dialogues.en: She walked off at a steady pace.
dialogues.text: She walked off at a steady pace.

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩が俺の荷物を全部持ち、先を歩く。
dialogues.en: Then she turned her head around, and waved. I waved back.
dialogues.text: Then she turned her head around, and waved. I waved back.

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩の開けてくれた扉から廊下に出る。
dialogues.en:
She continued walking, then turned and waved again. Under
the glare of a streetlamp, she looked like an actress in a
play.
dialogues.text:
She continued walking, then turned and waved again. Under
the glare of a streetlamp, she looked like an actress in a
play.

dialogues.jp:
肩越しに振り返り、閉じていく扉の隙間から病
室を見る。不思議なもので、ちょっと名残惜し
さを感じる。
dialogues.en: A few more steps, then another turn and wave.
dialogues.text: A few more steps, then another turn and wave.

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、あのバカ両親ども、１度も見舞い
に来なかったか……。
dialogues.en: A few steps.
dialogues.text: A few steps.

dialogues.jp:
「さすが俺の親……骨折程度では帰ってこない
　とは……」
dialogues.en: The turn of head.
dialogues.text: The turn of head.

dialogues.jp: 立ち止まる俺を見上げる萌先輩。
dialogues.en: The wave of hand.
dialogues.text: The wave of hand.

dialogues.jp: 「……あ、なんでもないです。行きましょう」
dialogues.en:
...She kept doing that until I finally lost sight of her in
the darkness.
dialogues.text:
...She kept doing that until I finally lost sight of her in
the darkness.

dialogues.jp: 松葉杖をつき、受付に向かう。
いつの間にか、季節は春になっていた……。
dialogues.en: "...She really is being strange..."
dialogues.text: "...She really is being strange..."

dialogues.jp: ◆退院◆
dialogues.en: "...I hope she'd be okay for tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "...I hope she'd be okay for tomorrow."

dialogues.jp:
意外とケガの治りが早く、今日、退院出来る
事になった。
dialogues.en: ◆Going Home◆
dialogues.text: ◆Going Home◆

dialogues.jp:
入院中、萌先輩は親身に世話してくれた。退院
する事で、親密な関係が終わってしまうのが、
少し惜しい気がした……。
dialogues.en:
After doing our stuff, I watched Kotori's figure disappear
down the street.
dialogues.text:
After doing our stuff, I watched Kotori's figure disappear
down the street.
